name: rea
description: Runs the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server wherever your Claude session runs: Claude Code, Claude Desktop (and claude.ai sessions linked to it), and claude.ai cloud sessions. Engines install themselves on first use on Windows, macOS and Linux — JDK 21 if needed, Ghidra 12.1.4 (SHA-256 verified), jadx, optional apktool/radare2 — picked for your OS and CPU, resumable and offline-capable, with self-repair and a pinned upgrade path. Reverse-engineering prompts are routed to REA automatically. Ships REA's investigation skill, guided per-target workflows, a shareable HTML/Markdown report generator, and /rea:analyze, /rea:report, /rea:doctor, /rea:capabilities, /rea:install-engines, /rea:setup-mcp (project-level .mcp.json for claude.ai cloud sessions, which skip plugin MCP servers).
